stem: Based on paragraphs 1 through 3, what can the reader infer about the author?

options.label: A
options.text: The author wishes she felt differently about meeting up with friends.

options.label: B
options.text: The author believes that she has been away from home for too long.

options.label: C
options.text: The author is nervous about visiting with people she has not seen for a while.

options.label: D
options.text: The author has made too many plans to meet with friends.
